messages:
Maria: heads up — noticed ~30 leads in the last 2h marked "unowned" in HS, they never hit SDR queue. Anyone else seeing this?
Jess: yep saw it — enrichment webhook timed out 504 -> didn't create owner. Looks like HS enrichment step failing for some regions.
Oliver: I picked a few manually. Is there fallback to default owner? Noticed round-robin didn't assign.
Sam: Quick context: we recently added 8s timeout on enrichment webhook to avoid pipeline stalls. If enrichment doesn't return, we currently drop owner assignment. That might be too aggressive.
Maria: can we change to fallback to pool owner instead of dropping? Need <1h fix to prevent leads getting stale.
Jess: propose: set HS workflow to 8s -> still call enrichment, but if timeout -> assign to "inbound-ops" queue and tag for re-enrich. Rollout can be via HS workflows.
Maria: sounds good. Can you sketch steps? Include HubSpot filter snippet
Jess: paste snippet:
```yaml
workflow:
  trigger: new_contact
  action:
    - call: /enrich-v1
      timeout_ms: 8000
    - if: response.ok
        assign: round_robin
      else:
        assign: inbox:inbound-ops
        tag: re-enrich-needed
```
Oliver: do we need SFDC mapping change too? Stale leads create duplicates sometimes.
Sam: yes, need to ensure HubSpot->SF mapping checks owner field before create; if owner missing, set owner = inbound_ops_user_id. I'll open infra ticket INF-5013.
Maria: ok can we also add heartbeat alert in Datadog when >10 unowned leads in 15m?
Sam: already on it, will add monitor and set P0 -> #marketing oncall. Ticket: INF-5012.
Jess: timeline: change HS workflow now in sandbox, smoke test, then prod in 30 min. I'll own rollout.
Maria: thanks. Quick note: track count in marketing dashboard so we can see impact. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: automation ran: hs-workflow-updates/sandbox applied by jess at 1767004360
Jess: applied prod at 1767004385 — monitoring now.
Maria: all good so far, owners flowing. closing triage; will do retrospective tomorrow 10am.
Oliver: ok, will follow up on duplicate checks.
